name: Bing Webmaster Tools API
description: The Bing Webmaster Tools API lets site owners manage and monitor their sites in Bing's index programmatically: add and verify sites, submit URLs and content for indexing, manage sitemaps/feeds, retrieve crawl statistics and issues, query traffic and keyword statistics, manage inbound link data, and configure crawl, URL-normalization, country/region, and page-preview settings. All operations are invoked over a JSON web API at https://ssl.bing.com/webmaster/api.svc/json/{Method} and authenticated with an API key passed as the `apikey` query parameter (generated in the Bing Webmaster Tools portal under Settings > API Access).
